feasibility: Young-root pressure contrast at approximately restored pO2 and oxygen effect at 50 kPa

replication: By sample title: root97/75/50/25/10 kPa3 each, no root5 kPa;shoot75 kPa4, others3. Four75 kPa samples conflict between shoot title and root tissue field.

conditions: 10 versus 97 kPa; 1,3,6,12,48,72 h; reported 21% O2
feasibility: Organ-by-time combined low-pressure/low-pO2 response; 24 h supplied by gradient study only
limitations: Severe hypobaria far from NASA target; oxygen partial pressure changes with pressure. Published DE threshold used nominal P despite discussion of BH in methods.
